decision: The exact free official present-vintage source passed identity, monthly-lattice and total-observation checks. Design contained only six non-positive year-over-year months versus the frozen minimum of ten. Validation passed all support gates, but the contract denied partial admission. Close without economic testing.
prohibited_reopen: Do not lower the Design minimum-state gate from ten to six after observing factor values.
Do not use Validation support to waive a failed Design gate or exclude the 2020 shock period.
Do not scan nominal sales, CPI separately, month-over-month change, surprises, magnitude thresholds, categories, smoothing, another release lag or inverse direction.
Do not combine RRSFS with INDPRO, PERMIT, UMCSENT or another factor as a rescue.
Do not open BTC outcomes, create a hypothesis, manifest, economic runner, candidate or OOS for this closed family.
learning: A real-activity feature can alternate often while still provide too little support for its economically important contraction state. Design was positive in 42 of 48 months, so a long-or-cash result would be dominated by near-continuous BTC participation and a handful of exceptional months.
scope_note: No BTC outcome, hypothesis, manifest, economic runner, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
